data.title: What's New, What's Next in AI Content. Forty-five minutes, no fluff.
paragraphs: The tools change every week. What that means for the people who make content, and the companies paying for it, moves slower than the hype and faster than most teams can keep up with.
This session walks through what shipped, what is coming, and where the line between human and machine work is settling. You leave knowing what to use, what to skip, and what to build next.

data.title: Two people who write for a living, talking about what changed
data.subtitle: No panel of ten. Just the work, from the people who do it.

steps.title: What's Coming

steps.title: Agentic Workflows
steps.text: Where agents take the repetitive work, catalog copy, briefs, first drafts, so your team spends its time on the work that needs a human.

items.question: When is it?
items.answer: The second Thursday of the month at 11:00 AM Central. The session runs 45 minutes with time for questions at the end.

items.question: Is it free?
items.answer: Yes. Free to attend, and free to watch later. Registering is the only step.

items.question: Who is it for?
items.answer: Content leads, marketing owners, operators, and founders who want a clear read on where AI content is heading without the hype.

items.question: Will there be a recording?
items.answer: Yes. Everyone who registers gets the recording at the same email, so signing up is worth it even if you cannot make the live time.
